name: cloudflare-mcp
description: Inspect a single Cloudflare zone: DNS records, zone/SSL settings, Tunnels, and Zero Trust Access — read-only.
long_description: Gives Claude read-only visibility into a single Cloudflare zone. Lists and inspects DNS records, zone settings (including SSL/TLS mode), Universal SSL settings, Cloudflare Tunnels and their ingress configuration, and Zero Trust Access applications and groups. No create, update, or delete actions are exposed — this extension cannot modify your Cloudflare configuration in any way.

cloudflare_zone_name.title: Cloudflare Zone (Domain) Name
cloudflare_zone_name.description: The domain this server inspects, e.g. foxcore.dev

cloudflare_api_token.title: Cloudflare API Token
cloudflare_api_token.description: API token from Cloudflare dashboard > My Profile > API Tokens. Needs Zone:Read, DNS:Read, and (if using Tunnel/Access tools) Account:Read, Cloudflare Tunnel:Read, Access: Apps and Policies:Read. Stored securely in your OS keychain.

cloudflare_account_id.title: Cloudflare Account ID
cloudflare_account_id.description: Required only for Tunnel and Zero Trust Access tools. Found in the Cloudflare dashboard sidebar.

tools.name: verify_token
tools.description: Verify the configured API token and check its status/scope.

tools.name: get_zone
tools.description: Get details for the configured zone.

tools.name: get_zone_settings
tools.description: Get all zone settings, including SSL mode.

tools.name: get_ssl_universal_settings
tools.description: Get Universal SSL settings for the zone.

tools.name: list_dns_records
tools.description: List DNS records for the zone, optionally filtered by type.

tools.name: get_dns_record
tools.description: Get details for a single DNS record by ID.

tools.name: list_tunnels
tools.description: List Cloudflare Tunnels on the account.

tools.name: get_tunnel
tools.description: Get details for a specific Tunnel.

tools.name: get_tunnel_configuration
tools.description: Get ingress configuration for a Tunnel.
